existingIntakeCheck.method: Original paths and SHA256 against the two registered manifests; no inference.

variants.instructions: Clean complete board, nearly frontal camera, usual comfortable distance and diffuse light.
Same position and view; moderate side angle, slightly changed distance and modest lighting variation. Keep every edge visible and pieces readable. Record actual conditions.
Keep photo-02 camera geometry, distance, lighting and piece placement. Add only recorded usual marks; capture the newly marked screen reference too.

marksPolicy.requirements: Record exact squares/endpoints and appearance; include empty and occupied, light and dark squares across sessions. Prefer ordinary marks; no opaque occlusion or crossed-arrow expansion. Do not change pieces to add a last-move mark.

identityGate: Use the local reference gallery to identify all three selectors. Preserve a screenshot of the selected piece/background settings. Similar-looking artwork is not a verified match; leave unknown values null and review before collecting a larger batch.

rules: Record game ID or video URL and timestamp, or an explicitly identified new editor position. A local source label suffices to link related sessions.
Same game/video, related positions, screenshots and every photo/background/orientation/mark variant stay together.
Check hashes, placement families and available source IDs against existing development and validation before admission.
If a position or source overlaps validation, retain that partition; do not admit it to new training.
Unknown provenance stays conservatively grouped; no random square/photo split or claim of independent validation.

reviewGate: Match photo to direct screenshot, placement, orientation and actual piece/background selector. Do not use model predictions as labels.
Review all four board corners, readability, absence of animation and correct target board.
Count 13 classes by design and canonical square color; inspect light/dark empty squares and color-confusion pairs explicitly.
Record angle, distance, lighting, marks, texture and moire as observed, not assumed from the planned slot.
Report received and usable counts, rejected/ambiguous samples, source-group count and coverage gaps before expanding.
Compare reviewed-corner classification and automatic geometry later; this preparation step runs neither.
falseKnightNote: Empty-square examples in the pilot probe false pieces across target styles. video-img_5406 (false knight h8) has a different visual group and remains an explicit control; recovery is not assumed. video-img_5404 produced false rook/bishop, not knights.
scopeLimit: Six of the fourteen planned catalogue pairs, not full catalogue coverage. Four named baseline designs remain existing controls. No training or final acceptance until separate review.
expansionRule: After the 18-photo pilot, collect only missing class/color/style/background/condition/source coverage. Several photos of one position are variants, not independent positions.
